description: Source code for SDSLib 2.0, a C library implementing dynamic strings with various header types and string manipulation functions, including creation, duplication, concatenation, trimming, splitting, and formatting.

methods.name: sdsnewlen
methods.description: Creates a new SDS string with specified content and length, optionally uninitialized or zeroed based on input.

methods.name: sdsempty
methods.description: Creates an empty SDS string with null terminator.

methods.name: sdsnew
methods.description: Creates a new SDS string from a null-terminated C string.

methods.name: sdsdup
methods.description: Duplicates an existing SDS string.

methods.name: sdsfree
methods.description: Frees an SDS string.

methods.name: sdsupdatelen
methods.description: Updates SDS string length based on current strlen() (useful after manual modifications).

methods.name: sdsclear
methods.description: Resets SDS string to zero length, keeping buffer for future appends.

methods.name: sdsMakeRoomFor
methods.description: Enlarges SDS buffer to ensure space for additional data.

methods.name: sdsRemoveFreeSpace
methods.description: Reallocates SDS buffer to remove unused free space.

methods.name: sdsAllocSize
methods.description: Returns total allocated size including header, string, and null terminator.

methods.name: sdsAllocPtr
methods.description: Returns pointer to the start of the SDS allocation.

methods.name: sdsIncrLen
methods.description: Increments or decrements SDS string length, updating null terminator.

methods.name: sdsgrowzero
methods.description: Grows SDS string to specified length, zero-filling new space.

methods.name: sdscatlen
methods.description: Appends binary-safe data to SDS string.

methods.name: sdscat
methods.description: Appends null-terminated string to SDS string.

methods.name: sdscatsds
methods.description: Appends another SDS string.

methods.name: sdscpylen
methods.description: Replaces SDS string content with binary-safe data.

methods.name: sdscpy
methods.description: Replaces SDS string content with null-terminated string.

methods.name: sdsll2str
methods.description: Converts long long to string, returns length.

methods.name: sdsull2str
methods.description: Converts unsigned long long to string, returns length.

methods.name: sdsfromlonglong
methods.description: Creates SDS string from long long value.

methods.name: sdscatvprintf
methods.description: Appends formatted string using va_list.

methods.name: sdscatprintf
methods.description: Appends formatted string.

methods.name: sdscatfmt
methods.description: Appends formatted string with limited format specifiers for performance.

methods.name: sdstrim
methods.description: Trims characters from start and end based on cset.

methods.name: sdsrange
methods.description: Extracts substring based on start and end indices.

methods.name: sdstolower
methods.description: Converts SDS string to lowercase.

methods.name: sdstoupper
methods.description: Converts SDS string to uppercase.

methods.name: sdscmp
methods.description: Compares two SDS strings.

methods.name: sdssplitlen
methods.description: Splits string into tokens based on separator.

methods.name: sdsfreesplitres
methods.description: Frees array of SDS tokens.

methods.name: sdscatrepr
methods.description: Appends escaped representation of string.

methods.name: sdssplitargs
methods.description: Splits line into arguments considering quotes and escapes.

methods.name: sdsmapchars
methods.description: Replaces characters in SDS string based on mapping.

methods.name: sdsjoin
methods.description: Joins array of C strings with separator into SDS string.

methods.name: sdsjoinsds
methods.description: Joins array of SDS strings with separator into SDS string.
